summary: Iter 232N.56 Metric Explorer — backend + frontend fully verified. All 14 pytest tests pass (N56 new suite + N54/N55 regression). Backend endpoints /api/admin/daily-metrics/registered and /api/admin/daily-metrics return correct enriched shapes. Frontend Metric Explorer tab loads, panel + all testid selectors present, dropdowns populated from API, metric switch (Commissioner Activity ↔ Draft Picks Made) handled gracefully with empty-state message, trend LineChart and horizontal BarChart leaderboard render via recharts, totals + breakdown chips + freshness ('Last rolled up: 2026-07-08') shown, copy-JSON and download-CSV buttons enabled, window/limit/refresh all trigger reloads without errors.

issues: The two-line SelectValue (metric name + description) overflows the SelectTrigger padding and overlaps the METRIC label slightly at 1920px — cosmetic only; consider showing just the humanized key in the trigger and keeping the description in the dropdown options.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Trim SelectValue in metric-explorer-metric-select to show only the humanized key so the trigger height stays 1 line.
critical_code_review_comments: MetricExplorerPanel.tsx (~703 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting the trend and leaderboard chart sub-components into their own files for maintainability.

loadRegistered uses setSelectedMetric with a functional updater that also calls setSelectedKind inside the setter — this is a React anti-pattern (side effect inside a setter). It works but is fragile; move the auto-select into an effect keyed on `metrics`.
seed_data_creation: None; existing TFHL commissioner_activity rollup row on 2026-07-08 was sufficient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metric Explorer fully working. Discovery endpoint returns kinds+last_seen_day; Draft Picks Made currently has 0 rollup rows and the panel handles that gracefully. If new metrics are added to services/daily_rollup.py, the panel will auto-list them without frontend changes.
